tut_cook.title: Fresh off the Pad
tut_cook.intro: So you're the one the Consortium staked a ship to. Six grand by day twelve, huh? Then quit standing on my pad. Buds at the market, the old cannery is yours to use. Let's see if you can cook.

steps.text: Buy 5 Cannabis Buds at the Mireth market
steps.hint: Walk to the market door and press E. Put the buds in the basket, then Checkout.

steps.text: Walk into the Old Cannery
steps.hint: The cannery is your free starter lab. Press E at its door.

steps.text: Start a tray of Weed at the Trim Table
steps.hint: Press E at the Trim Table, pick an amount and snip the fan leaves.

steps.text: Mix Ion Syrup into the batch at the Mixing Station
steps.hint: Okka slipped you a jar of Ion Syrup. Additives change the traits and the price.

steps.text: Carry the tray through the rest of the line
steps.hint: The glowing frame marks the next station. Each minigame decides yield, grade or heat.

steps.text: Collect the cooked batch from the stash crate
steps.hint: Cooking takes a little while. The HUD shows the lab progress.

tut_cook.outro: Not bad for a pilot. Now let's talk about what that stuff is worth.

tut_price.title: Know Your Product
tut_price.intro: Every mix you cook lands in the Products app on your Com-Phone. Look it up and put a price on it. Too greedy and nobody bites.

steps.text: Open the Products app on your Com-Phone
steps.hint: Press the phone key, then tap Products.

steps.text: Set an asking price for your new Weed
steps.hint: Tap the product, then use the price buttons. Market = buyers pay what they offer.

tut_deal.title: Street Business
tut_deal.intro: Customers text you on the Deal-O-Matic: how much, what price, when. I'll go first. Check your phone.

steps.text: Accept Okka's request in the Deal-O-Matic
steps.retry_text: Missed that one? I'll text again.
steps.hint: Accept, or counter the amount or the time if you can't make it.

steps.text: Meet Okka at the agreed time and hand it over
steps.retry_text: You stood me up. Let's try that again.
steps.hint: Be there inside the time window. A marker shows over the buyer.

tut_deal.outro: Pleasure. Teo Brack down the street wants in too, I gave him your number.

tut_dealer.title: Let Others Sell
tut_dealer.intro: You can't stand on every corner yourself. Hire a street dealer in the HR app, give them product, and collect the cash later.

steps.text: Hire a street dealer in the HR app
steps.hint: Dealers take a cut and can get busted, but they sell while you fly.

steps.text: Give your dealer product to sell
steps.hint: Open the dealer, pick a district and hand over some units.

tut_dealer.outro: That's the whole trade, kid. Cook, price, deal, delegate. The Consortium will want its money. Don't make them come for it.

main_collector.title: The Collector
main_collector.intro: Mara Vesk here, Ouroboros Consortium, accounts receivable. The Consortium is patient, not generous. Show me good faith: one thousand credits at the Mireth office, and I'll tell my people you are worth the wait.

steps.text: Pay 1,000 cr of your debt at the Mireth office
steps.hint: Office → Debt. Partial payments count.

main_collector.outro: Good faith noted. Two more days on your clock. Don't make me regret it.

main_annex.title: Room to Grow
main_annex.intro: One cannery won't pay off Vesk. The annex behind it is for sale, or look on other planets. More rooms, more lines, more product.

steps.text: Buy a second estate
steps.hint: Walk to an estate door and press E to see the price. Build stations inside with the build menu.

main_heavier.title: Heavier Product
main_heavier.intro: Weed pays the rent, not the Consortium. Coca Leaf comes from the Cinder Belt. Cook a tray of Cocaine on the Precursor Scale line and Dr. Vesna Holt will want to meet you.

steps.text: Buy Coca Leaf at the Cinder Belt
steps.hint: Fly to the Cinder Belt Outpost and land.

steps.text: Cook a batch of Cocaine or something stronger
steps.hint: Cocaine starts on the Precursor Scale in the Old Cannery.

main_heavier.outro: Vesna Holt's number is on your phone now. Doctors pay well and ask nothing.

main_kovar.title: Out of Reach
main_kovar.intro: Rhea Dunmore, Varrow. Word travels: you cook clean. The Authority barely patrols Kovar and I have buyers who never see good stuff. Jump through the Halvane gate and land at Varrow.

steps.text: Jump to the Kovar system
steps.hint: Fly to the jump gate (toll 80 cr) or plan a jump in the Map app.

steps.text: Land on Varrow
steps.hint: Varrow is lawless: no fence, few patrols.

main_rhea.title: Desert Friends
main_rhea.intro: Bring me something with a kick, Meth or Cocaine. Ten units, and you'll meet my runner Kip.

steps.text: Sell 10 units to Rhea Dunmore
steps.hint: Talk to her on Varrow, or accept her texts in the Deal-O-Matic.

main_rhea.outro: Kip runs my errands. Use him. And watch the lanes, the Black Comets have been jumping traders.

main_comets.title: Black Comets
main_comets.intro: The Black Comets are a cartel crew raiding the lanes between our systems. Every wreck is a bounty and a message. Shoot down three of their raiders.

steps.text: Shoot down 3 Black Comet raiders
steps.hint: Raiders show up in flight. Laser and missiles, upgrades at a shipyard mechanic.

main_comets.outro: Three less. They'll remember your ship. Good, let them be afraid.

main_clear.title: Clean Slate
main_clear.intro: I hear about you everywhere now, which is bad for business. Settle the account and the Consortium forgets your name.

steps.text: Pay off the whole debt
steps.hint: Office → Debt.

main_clear.outro: Account closed. A word of advice: the Black Comets are not the only cartel out there, and they all want what you just built.

main_turf.title: Turf War
main_turf.intro: Debt's gone, so now the cartels see you as competition. Fine. Pick a street and own it: sell there, put a dealer on it, and hold more than half of it.

steps.text: Make one location your turf (over 50% influence)
steps.hint: Com-Phone → Map → Influence shows who holds what. Sales and dealers take ground.

main_turf.outro: That's a flag in the ground. The Comets will come for it. Let them.

main_lanes.title: Toll Road
main_lanes.intro: The cartels pull haulers out of hyperspace and call it a toll. Next time it happens to you, deal with it: pay, dump, run or shoot. Just live.

steps.text: Get through an interdiction on a jump
steps.hint: Jump between systems with product aboard. Angry cartels and high heat make it likelier.

main_lanes.outro: Now you know how they work. Time to hit them where they sleep.

main_nest.title: Smoke the Nest
main_nest.intro: Vash Orrin runs the Black Comets out of a gutted ore hauler in deep Halvane space. Four turrets, a hangar of fighters. Bring missiles, flak or ion, and a hull that can take it. Burn it.

steps.text: Destroy the Comet Nest
steps.hint: Ion bolts hit bases twice as hard. A Corvette from the shipyard helps.

main_nest.outro: Halvane just got a lot quieter. Ilse Marrow called. She wasn't congratulating you.

main_rig.title: Cold Front
main_rig.intro: The Saltglass Tide put a price on your head. Their rig sits in deep Kovar space with gunship escorts. Take it out before their wings take you out.

steps.text: Destroy the Saltglass Rig in Kovar
steps.hint: Gunships take double ion damage. Repair and restock at Mireth's mechanic first.

main_rig.outro: Two cartels bleeding, one still watching from Varrow. That's the Ninth Veil's game, and it's a longer one.

main_veil_whisper.title: Whispers on Varrow
main_veil_whisper.intro: Two cartels down and the dust towns on Varrow still hum like nothing happened. That's the Ninth Veil: Sister Quill buys faith with cheap product and keeps it with knives. Go back to Varrow and find Captain Jex Ferro. He's sick of sweeping up after them.

steps.text: Land on Varrow
steps.hint: Kovar's gate is on the far side of Halvane. Varrow is the dune town.

main_veil_whisper.outro: Ferro will tell you where the Veil is soft, if you can keep him out of the report.

main_veil_ground.title: Cheap Faith
main_veil_ground.intro: The Veil hands out free first doses in every dust town and calls it a blessing. Take a street off them. Better product, better prices, a dealer on the corner. When people have a choice they stop praying to Quill.

steps.text: Take a location away from the Ninth Veil
steps.hint: Com-Phone → Map → Influence. Varrow and the Bazaar are where the Veil holds ground.

main_veil_ground.outro: You'll hear about this in church on Sunday. Expect the Veil to answer, they never forgive a lost street.

main_veil_toll.title: The Quiet Toll
main_veil_toll.intro: My scanner has been seeing a lot of purple lanterns near the Kovar gate. The Veil does not tax haulers, it recruits them. Fly through their space with product aboard and see what they want from you. Survive the conversation.

steps.text: Get through an interdiction by the Ninth Veil
steps.hint: Jump into Kovar with product aboard. The more the Veil dislikes you, the likelier they stop you.

main_veil_toll.outro: Now you've met their lantern-bearers. Polite, quiet and armed. I put your name on my good list. It costs extra.

main_veil_wing.title: Lanterns Out
main_veil_wing.intro: Sister Quill's novices fly the fighters out of Veil Spire, and they are fearless in a way that gets people killed. Put four of them down before you go anywhere near the Spire. Her wing is thin, but she'll replace it fast.

steps.text: Shoot down 4 Ninth Veil ships
steps.hint: They fly near the Spire and in Kovar space. Missiles and flak clear fighter packs.

main_veil_wing.outro: That should thin the choir. The Spire itself is next. Bring the best hull you own.

main_veil_spire.title: Veil Spire
main_veil_spire.intro: A shrine-station lit like a lantern, deep in Kovar's southern dark. Sister Quill sleeps there and prays there and keeps her ledger there. Burn the Spire and the Ninth Veil loses its voice.

steps.text: Destroy Veil Spire
steps.hint: Ion bolts hit bases twice as hard. Repair and restock at Mireth's mechanic first.

main_veil_spire.outro: The lanterns went out one by one. Jex Ferro says the dust towns are quiet. Quiet in a good way, for once.

main_veil_ledger.title: Quill's Ledger
main_veil_ledger.intro: Among the wreckage of the Spire they found Quill's ledger, and half the Kovar books are in it. My signature can make that disappear, or put it in front of the Consortium. Come to Glacis with money and we will discuss which.

steps.text: Land on Glacis
steps.hint: Glacis is the cryo dome planet in Kovar.

steps.text: Bring 5,000 cr to settle the audit
steps.hint: Sell product, or collect from your dealers.

main_veil_ledger.outro: Pleasure doing business. Three cartels broken, one empire's worth of ground on your side of the table. Chapter 3 closed. What you build on it is up to you.
